description: Search record content (notes, activity, communications). Never modify note content or attachments. Requires resource_type and content_query; optional fields array. Narrow scope with fields or switch to search_records_advanced.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

resource_type.description: Type of resource to operate on. Standard types: companies, people, deals, tasks, lists, records, notes. Custom objects (e.g., "funds", "investment_opportunities") are also supported after running `attio-discover attributes -a`.

name: search_records_by_content
